name: {{NAME}}

cadence.note: One video a day on weekdays, posted by hand the same evening to every app.

character.anchors: {{IDENTITY_ANCHORS: face shape, hair, eyes, skin, build, signature jewellery — copied verbatim into every video prompt}}

voice.delivery: {{VOICE_DELIVERY: e.g. warm, unhurried, dry; Australian accent}}

writing_voice: {{WRITING_VOICE: how they talk — sentence length, pet phrases, what they never say}}
cta_style: One soft line at most, in character (e.g. 'Part two tomorrow.'). Never beg for likes.
hook_formulas: Direct callout: 'If you're [specific viewer], stop scrolling.'
Specific number + stakes: 'I lost 3 years to one bad habit.'
Confession / storytime: 'Nobody knows I did this.'
POV: 'POV: you just [moment the audience recognises].'
script_rules: 15-40 seconds total; a single talking take is at most 28 seconds of speech.
First spoken line is the hook: 8 words or fewer, no greeting.
Every line earns the next; the last line pays off the hold and loops to the hook.
Write in the character's voice, never neutral copywriter voice.
Facts only from sources the checker can open; storytime from the fictional backstory needs none.
safety_rules: The character is fictional and never claims real credentials.
No financial, medical or legal advice; general information only.
No likeness of a real person; no real brand logos; no fake reviews or testimonials.
Turn on each platform's AI-generated content label when posting.

trend_scout.how: Runs inside the Higgsfield sandbox (open internet) with yt_dlp: titles, views and lengths only.
